notes.title: horizontal patch
notes.content: made the jump heavier without accounting for how crud that made the horizontal air movement. fixed that. also fixed the mountain climb in level 2 to be less buggy.

notes.title: the heavy patch
notes.content:
the cast of floogen gained weight. jumping is more heavy to hopefully get rid of the 'floaty' feel. 

enemies wont respawn now unless you break the checkpoints, initiating 'hardcore mode'.
hopefully this also makes the game a little more fair.

notes.title: patch so and so
notes.content: Fishing works again, Napolians level can be completed in world 2, and the tentacles in the final boss give you some time before they bring the pain.

notes.title: patch 7?
notes.content:
The raven learned to not drop our soldiers into the swamp but still didn't quite hit the mark. That raven was let go later that day and has been replaced by an identical raven. 

The pipes in hell splurt out danger less often making it more tolerable. 

The platforms in hell are easier to jump upon and no longer have you fall through them occasionally.

notes.title: patch 4
notes.content:
The evil Floogen had put an invisible barrier on the Tower. I sent in some mages to destroy it. You're free to eradiate the Floogen from the forest now. 

Additionally, the swamp now dyes you purple as a nice visual flair.

notes.title: patch 3 [Seb Mode]
notes.content:
Ring the bell after five or more deaths on a level and press the Blue Button to enable Seb Mode. In Seb Mode, you won't take damage. You will still die from falls but this may be a nice option for anyone struggling.
